Title: Autoscale public preview is now available for Azure Virtual Desktop

Body.Content:
Autoscale for Azure Virtual Desktop enables you to:

  • Start and stop session host VMs based on schedule and demand throughout the phases of a typical workday.
  • Save costs by shutting down idle session hosts during off peak hours while ensuring enough capacity to meet users’ needs during peak hours.
  • Support multiple schedules and usage patterns.
  • Integrate with the Azure Portal management plane for simple configuration.
  • Set up a scaling plan once and apply it to as many host pools as you choose.
  • Maintain control of the log off user experience based on needs.

Learn more.
